sprint.title: One Player-Safe Local Route Guidance Projection
sprint.goal: Derive one deterministic, player-safe presentation of the current scene's immediate traversable connections as natural local route cues, without turning navigation into a compass grid or destination-routing system.
acceptance_criteria: Route cues describe only immediate, traversable connections from the current player scene; they do not describe the relative position of non-adjacent or merely known destinations.
Cues are deterministic, player-safe, and phrased as natural local routes, for example `Main Street continues south into town.`
Local orientation may be included only where it meaningfully describes an immediate route; the result is not a raw compass grid.
Structural connectivity remains authoritative and separate from the derived presentation projection; movement behavior is unchanged.
The projection adds no World State, history, save data, narration context, provider authority, migration, or save-version change.

staging_commands: Official-interpreter preflight through the established workspace procedure
focused_commands: Affected navigation, movement, scene, save/load, narration-context, and provider-safe regressions

governance: No sprint or capability package is currently active or staged.
Simulation retains authority over structural connectivity and movement; route cues are deterministic, player-safe, derived presentation only.
Project only immediate traversable connections relevant to the current scene; never infer or expose nonlocal destination relationships.
Do not add persistence, history, parser, command, provider, navigation-framework, migration, or save-version changes. Save version remains 1.
Provider requests are forbidden for automated verification, and next_sprint remains null.
